question: Should omitting `plugins.entries.active-memory.config.agents` remain fail-closed, or become an instruction to target every configured agent with implicit `main` fallback?
rationale: Both contracts are technically implementable, but the choice controls hidden personalization and model calls for existing configurations and therefore requires explicit product and upgrade intent.

options.title: Preserve Explicit Opt-In
options.body: Keep omission fail-closed and address setup friction by having onboarding, configuration UI, or a repair flow write explicit agent IDs.

options.title: Approve Inherited Targeting
options.body: Adopt this PR's omission semantics after documenting the upgrade impact and adding direct final-head runtime proof for omitted, empty, and explicit lists.

options.title: Pause For Broader Design
options.body: Hold or close this PR while the Memory owner defines a durable targeting convention shared with comparable allowlist surfaces.

recommendation.title: Preserve Explicit Opt-In
recommendation.body: Keep omission fail-closed and address setup friction by having onboarding, configuration UI, or a repair flow write explicit agent IDs.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository explicitly routes Memory product ownership to this maintainer, and the unresolved question is the permanent Active Memory default contract.
